Container.Name: NASearch
Container.Overview:
NASearch — a lightweight, self-hosted file search UI for your Unraid array.
Powered by plocate, it indexes your entire array in seconds and delivers instant search across millions of files — directly in your browser.
FEATURES • Rich file previews — images, video (with seek), audio, PDF, rendered Markdown, interactive 3D STL models (WebGL, no plugins), and ZIP contents browser — all inline. • Folder browsing — click any result to explore its directory tree; download individual files or whole folders as ZIP archives. • Secure login — session-cookie authentication with CSRF protection and rate limiting. No credentials in URLs. • Themes & colour customisation — built-in dark, purple, slate, and light themes; set your own background, text, and accent colours; optional scanline overlay. • Auto-indexing — configurable scheduler (1 h to 7 days) or manual trigger via the UI; real-time progress indicator.
No Elasticsearch. No Node. No build step. One container, one volume.
IMPORTANT: You must set either AUTH_USER + AUTH_PASS (recommended) or NOAUTH=true before the app will start.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the NASearch web interface.

Config.Name: Array Path
Config.Description: Root of your Unraid array, mounted read-only. NASearch will index and serve files from here.

Config.Name: Index & Config Storage
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the plocate database and settings.json.

Config.Name: Auth Username
Config.Description: Login username. Set both AUTH_USER and AUTH_PASS to enable authentication (recommended).

Config.Name: Auth Password
Config.Description: Login password. Set both AUTH_USER and AUTH_PASS to enable authentication (recommended).

Config.Name: Disable Auth
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to explicitly disable authentication. Only use on a fully trusted, firewalled network. Either AUTH_USER+AUTH_PASS or NOAUTH=true must be set.

Config.Name: Prune Paths
Config.Description: Space-separated list of paths to skip during indexing.

Config.Name: Max Results
Config.Description: Maximum number of search results returned per query.

Config.Name: Homepage: Name
Config.Description: Display name shown on your Homepage dashboard. Leave blank if you are not using Homepage (https://gethomepage.dev).

Config.Name: Homepage: Group
Config.Description: Dashboard group/category to place NASearch in (e.g. Tools, Media, System). Leave blank if not using Homepage.

Config.Name: Homepage: URL
Config.Description: Full URL Homepage should link to (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000 or your reverse-proxy address). Leave blank if not using Homepage.
